description_en: Updates the configuration of a specified data diagnostic task
description_zh: 用于更新指定的数据诊断任务配置信息
name: UpdateDataDiagnosis

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data diagnostic task
parameters.name: data_diagnosis_id

parameters.help_en: The configuration details of the data diagnostic task. If `Type` is set to `ChangeRate`, include the analysis field (`AnalysisField`) and partition field format (`PartitionFieldFormat`). If `Type` is set to `PreferenceStatisticsCycle`, include the user ID field (`UserIdField`), single-day retention rate statistical period (`RemainDays`), appearance rate statistical period (`EverAppearedDays`), periodic retention rate statistical period (`RemainRatePeriods`), and partition field format (`PartitionFieldFormat`). If `Type` is set to `JoinTables`, include the left table analysis field (`LeftTableAnalysisField`), right table analysis field (`RightTableAnalysisField`), left table JOIN field (`LeftJoinField`), right table JOIN field (`RightJoinField`), sample quantity for display (`SampleQuantity`), left table partition field format (`LeftTablePartitionFieldFormat`), and right table partition field format (`RightTablePartitionFieldFormat`). If `Type` is set to `BaseStatistics`, include the Tag field (`TagField`), Tag field separator (`TagFieldSeparator`), KV field (`KVField`), KV field separator (`KVFieldSeparator`), KV pair separator (`KVPairSeparator`), Text field (`TextField`), data percentile distribution (`Quantiles`), default value for the string type (`DefaultValueOfString`), null value field for the string type (`NullStringField`), and partition field format (`PartitionFieldFormat`). If `Type` is set to `AbnormalBehavior`, include the user ID field (`UserId`), item ID field (`ItemId`), behavior field (`EventField`), upstream behavior value (`UpStreamBehavior`), downstream behavior value (`DownstreamBehavior`), number of buckets (`NumericHistogramBins`), and partition field format (`PartitionFieldFormat`)
parameters.help_zh: 数据诊断任务配置内容。若Type=ChangeRate，则需包含：分析字段（AnalysisField）、分区字段格式（PartitionFieldFormat）若Type=PreferenceStatisticsCycle，则需包含：用户ID字段（UserIdField）、单日留存率统计周期（RemainDays）、曾现率统计周期（EverAppearedDays）、周期留存率统计周期（RemainRatePeriods）、分区字段格式（PartitionFieldFormat）若Type=JoinTables，则需包含左表分析字段（LeftTableAnalysisField)、右表分析字段（RightTableAnalysisField)、左表JOIN字段（LeftJoinField）、右表JOIN字段（RightJoinField）、展示用抽样数量（SampleQuantity）、左表分区字段格式（LeftTablePartitionFieldFormat）、右表分区字段格式（RightTablePartitionFieldFormat）若Type=BaseStatistics，则需包含：Tag字段（TagField）、Tag字段分隔符(TagFieldSeparator)、kv字段(KVField)、kv字段分隔符(KVFieldSeparator)、kv对分隔符(KVPairSeparator)、Text字段（TextField）、数据百分位分布（Quantiles）、字符串类型默认值（DefaultValueOfString）、字符串类型空值字段（NullStringField）、分区字段格式（PartitionFieldFormat）若Type=AbnormalBehavior，则需包含：用户ID字段（UserId）、物品ID字段（ItemId）、行为字段(EventField)、上游行为取值(UpStreamBehavior)、下游行为取值(DownstreamBehavior)、分桶数量(NumericHistogramBins)、分区字段格式（PartitionFieldFormat）
parameters.name: config

parameters.help_en: The periodic execution time. If this field is left empty, the task does not run periodically. Format: HH:mm
parameters.help_zh: 周期运行时间（若该字段为空，则不进行周期运行）。格式为 HH:mm

parameters.help_en:
The type of the data diagnostic task. Valid values:
ChangeRate: item or user change rate analysis
PreferenceStatisticsCycle: user preference statistical period analysis
JoinTables: two-table association analysis
BaseStatistics: basic statistical analysis
AbnormalBehavior: abnormal behavior analysis
parameters.help_zh:
数据诊断任务类型。

ChangeRate：物品/用户变化率分析。

PreferenceStatisticsCycle：用户偏好统计周期分析。

JoinTables：两表关联分析。

BaseStatistics：基础统计分析。

AbnormalBehavior：异常行为分析
parameters.name: type
